name: @popcomputer/diffduck
description: A Codex plugin for reviewing code changes through before-and-after userland examples.
author: github.com/PatrickOgilvie

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/server/main.js --sourcemap
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run notices && bun scripts/package.ts
